principle: Scientific claims are data, not UI text.

modules.scope: Degree-preserving null-model testing for network structure.
modules.what_this_means: The tool compares an observed network statistic against a degree-preserving null distribution.
limitations: A result outside the null interval does not establish causality.
It does not establish a physical law or mechanism.
Small networks or insufficient null samples may produce unstable results.
Important findings require independent replication and domain review.

modules.scope: Controlled computational validation under registered non-Gaussian telemetry conditions.
modules.what_this_means: Benchmark 002 completed its registered reproducibility closure with a PASS under the tested computational conditions.
limitations: This is controlled computational evidence, not physical-system certification.
The result applies only to the tested benchmark conditions.
It does not establish universal detector performance.
Independent physical validation would be required for real-world safety claims.

modules.scope: Controlled computational stress testing across Gaussian, Laplace, Student-t df3 and Uniform noise families.
modules.what_this_means: Benchmark 003 failed its registered primary stress criteria. The failure is preserved as evidence rather than hidden or retuned.
limitations: The protocol coverage was partial: multiple signal dynamics were not executed.
The independent seed-batch replication criterion was not evaluated.
No universal normalized failure boundary was established.
This benchmark provides computational evidence only.

modules.scope: First frozen held-out evaluation on seeds 4201-4210, with no post-result detector retuning.
modules.what_this_means: The selected detector improved pooled held-out detection over the frozen baseline, but failed mandatory family-generalization and held-out seed-stability criteria.
limitations: Primary held-out result is FAIL despite 72.40% pooled detection.
Student-t df3 detection was 47.50%, below the registered 50% requirement.
Held-out seed spread was 18.75 percentage points, above the registered 10 pp limit.
This is controlled computational evidence, not physical certification.

modules.scope: Controlled synthetic multisensor fault detection and subsystem localization across registered operating regimes, non-Gaussian noise families and held-out seeds.
modules.what_this_means: Benchmark 005 passed all registered primary criteria in its one-shot frozen held-out evaluation under the tested controlled synthetic conditions.
limitations: This is controlled synthetic evidence, not real-world automotive or industrial diagnostic validation.
Subsystem localization does not establish unique component diagnosis.
The result does not establish safety certification or universal fault-detection performance.
No FPGA, ARM, HIL or real-world latency claim is established by this benchmark.

modules.scope: Pre-registered readiness for an independently supplied external benchmark specification, with immutable intake, hashing and audit controls prepared before execution.
modules.what_this_means: Benchmark 006 is prepared for external specification intake but has not yet been executed and therefore has no external validation result.
limitations: No GSRL external benchmark result has been produced yet.
No PASS or FAIL claim is made before receipt and execution of the external specification.
External acceptance criteria, datasets and latency constraints will not be invented or altered by E-ZERO.
Any future result will apply only to the externally supplied benchmark conditions actually executed.

modules.display_name: Read-Only OBD — Wi-Fi TCP Loopback Validation V0.1
modules.scope: Localhost-only Wi-Fi TCP transport validation for the E-ZERO read-only OBD stack, including ELM/STN text-protocol normalization, session integration and deterministic failure-state mapping.
modules.what_this_means: The localhost-only Wi-Fi TCP OBD transport path passed the registered software regression and targeted integration tests under the tested non-vehicle conditions.
limitations: This is localhost/non-vehicle validation and is not real-vehicle validation.
No physical OBD adapter or vehicle was connected during this validation.
This evidence does not establish REAL_OBD provenance.
No vehicle-control capability is enabled or authorized.
The result does not establish automotive safety certification or universal hardware compatibility.

modules.display_name: Read-Only OBD — Wi-Fi TCP Network-Capable Bench Validation V0.3
modules.scope: Network-capable Wi-Fi TCP physical-backend code path validated under pre-registered non-vehicle bench conditions using deterministic mocked socket infrastructure. Real network activation remained disabled by default.
modules.what_this_means: The pre-registered network-capable Wi-Fi TCP physical-backend bench-validation stage passed all 25 requirements under mocked non-vehicle conditions while preserving the read-only safety boundary and separate network-activation gate.
limitations: No real OBD adapter or real vehicle was connected during this validation.
REAL_NETWORK_ACTIVATION_ALLOWED remained false by default and real network activation is not authorized.
This evidence does not establish REAL_OBD provenance.
diagnostic_claim remains false; transport validation is not a vehicle diagnosis.
This result does not establish automotive safety certification, universal hardware compatibility, fault-localization validation, RUL validation or commercial certification.

modules.display_name: Read-Only OBD — BLE Mock Backend Software Validation V0.1
modules.scope: Deterministic software/mock validation of the E-ZERO BLE transport backend using explicit BLE service/characteristic profile metadata, central read-only command policy, exact timeout contracts, mocked process-local single-session enforcement, and zero real BLE/GATT I/O.
modules.what_this_means: The frozen mocked BLE backend software milestone passed its dedicated, targeted, and full regression suites while preserving explicit BLE profile roles, the central read-only safety boundary, exact timeout contracts, deterministic mocked single-session behavior, simulated provenance, and zero real BLE/GATT activity.
limitations: No real BLE adapter or physical GATT connection was used during this validation.
No BLE scanning, pairing, bonding, real service discovery, characteristic read/write, or subscription was performed.
No ECU or real vehicle was contacted.
This evidence does not establish REAL_OBD provenance.
diagnostic_claim remains false; software/mock transport validation is not a vehicle diagnosis.

This result does not establish physical BLE interoperability, universal adapter compatibility, automotive safety certification, fault-localization validity, RUL validity, or commercial diagnostic certification.

modules.display_name: Industrial Intelligence — Public Demo Readiness V0.1
modules.scope: Controlled public-software-demo readiness for E-ZERO Industrial Intelligence using frozen simulated/log-replay, sensor-quality, textile/garment profile, end-to-end demo-flow, and free read-only field-validation safety milestones. Public release is not yet authorized.
modules.what_this_means: The E-ZERO Industrial Intelligence controlled public software demo is live and evidence-registry backed. The registered public-readiness validation passed with zero errors and zero warnings. Public industrial inputs remain limited to SIMULATED and approved LOG_REPLAY evidence.
limitations: REAL_SENSOR is not authorized for the public demo; public demo inputs remain SIMULATED and approved LOG_REPLAY only.
The separately validated real-sensor acquisition software is software-only and does not establish successful physical sensor or live machine connection.
The public interface provides condition screening and evidence visibility, not diagnosis, root cause, causality, confirmed component failure, failure prediction, or RUL validation.
No industrial safety certification, maintenance certification, regulatory approval, universal protocol compatibility, or universal machine compatibility is established.
